decision: CLEAR bounded NavList header-text, marker-spacing and shared ScrollbarGutter implementation from f9f07b7988e22a26254bd4b84d13b10ca2f11c57 as retained unchanged at exact WIP tip ee669114e8ade4ba1ad7f882085741eeaa259f5f. No actionable findings in this scope; no application migration or product parity acceptance.
method: Independent read-only source review in separate detached sparse before/after worktrees; distinct Cargo target directories per revision; public external consumer with different keyed Unicode/long/empty data; cargo nextest only for Rust test execution. Reviewed source worktrees stayed clean. No application source imports or source edits, no push, no helper agents.

default_compatibility.compared: Byte-identical complete ratatui Buffer debug cells, projected complete hit registry, complete focus ring entries/bounds, runtime focus/focus-visible, cursor visibility/position/bar flag and projected cursor. Live versus projected buffers also equal at each checkpoint.
default_compatibility.data: Different domain keys and sections, wide/combining labels, long labels, selected item distinct from cursor where populated. Existing public API compiles on both revisions.
default_compatibility.default_source_reasoning: header_text_patch defaults None and retains the exact original paint_str(h.style) branch; marker_gap defaults0 and preserves draw/measure positions; ScrollbarGutter defaults Auto and is equivalent to the prior visible-and-overflow condition. New fields are forwarded through key/row type transitions.

new_contract_proof.header_text: Four-profile public consumer confirms header label-only styling, inherited global bold plus text italic, and unchanged left/right padding. Native whole-header slot test confirms slot precedence over text patch; source returns before text patch for all profiles. PartStyle.part_patch merges global and named overrides before text patch, so existing channels are retained.
new_contract_proof.gutter_geometry: Public ScrollRegion across four profiles,width0..8,height0..4,empty/fitting/overflow lengths,hidden/visible bar and Auto/Stable. Assert exactly one reserved column when requested, no reservation when hidden/empty area, track only for overflow, all hit rectangles within area.
new_contract_proof.marker_geometry: Public NavList across four profiles,width0..12,gaps0/1/3/u16::MAX, fitting/overflow and Auto/Stable. Assert icon position when it fits, complete row hit width after gutter reservation, clipping and empty-width safety. Native tests additionally drive stable-gutter keyboard and pointer activation.
new_contract_proof.api: Only public Termrock facade/component-author APIs used by external fixture; no application source imports or copied widget implementation. Generic borrowed StylePatch, additive builders, new public Auto/Stable enum and private fields preserve old consumer signatures. No new domain or application-specific rendering branch.
new_contract_proof.runtime: Single existing ScrollRegion draw/update and NavList row/part machinery retained; no second input/render system, input during measurement, new unsafe code, background task or shared mutable global introduced.

strict_clippy.command: cargo clippy --locked -p termrock-navigation -p termrock-runtime -p termrock --all-targets -- -D warnings

coverage_limits: Three pre-existing real-PTY fixture tests remain skipped in the native default suite. The author reported two forced fixtures fail with Device not configured; this reviewer did not rerun forced ignored tests or count them green.
External consumer fixtures compile with unused/dead-code warnings; strict Clippy clearance applies to the specified production packages, not those ad hoc fixtures.

The initial external launch failed metadata probing because an unrelated /private/tmp/Cargo.toml was treated as an ancestor workspace. Adding [workspace] only to the external consumer isolated it; failed logs are preserved. A later attempt to reuse an exclusive log filename stopped before execution; no source or expected output was modified.

Before/after proof compares the candidate parent and reviewed change, not the frozen application baseline. No tuiscotti real-CLI capture, terminal-mode/cleanup proof, application adoption, complete workspace gate, or repeated full product comparison was performed.

Only the four listed shared library files and their focused tests are cleared. Unrelated incoming Jackin/Viewport/composition changes in merge tip ee669114 are outside this review and receive no approval.
The generic contract remains to be adopted and verified in actual Holla/Showcase flows before library or product acceptance.
